---
title: "Chapter 12: Data Structures and Algorithms"
---

- For non-trivial data manipulation implementing the correct algorithm is important to maintain performance
- Many standard data structures and algorithms are prepackaged by the python standard library
- More complex pre-packaged data structures and types also exist for handling specialised data, including
    1. Date and time manipulations
    2. Handling monetary or other high-precision decimal values
    3. Saving and restoring program state, and more
- Where possible prefer using library-implementations over rolling your own
